item.title: Terrifying True Crime & Paranormal Mysteries That Will Haunt You! (Ad-Free)
item.description:
Michael Browne is a published author, award-winning podcast creator, and experienced media professional best known as the creator and host of the acclaimed Dark Poutine Podcast. With an extensive background in television, film, advertising, and digital media, Michael has developed a passion for storytelling that explores the darker and more mysterious sides of human experience. His expertise in writing, production, branding, and communication has helped him establish a distinctive voice in the world of podcasting, captivating audiences through compelling narratives and detailed research.

Through Dark Poutine, Michael explores true crime, historical mysteries, and unusual stories, bringing listeners into a world where disturbing events and unanswered questions often intersect. His storytelling combines thoughtful research, engaging narration, and a deep appreciation for the people and circumstances behind each case. With a fascination for both the unexplained and the extraordinary, Michael continues to entertain and inform audiences while exploring the mysteries, tragedies, and strange occurrences that leave lasting impressions on our world.

Spaced Out Radio is your nightly source for alternative information, starting at 9pm Pacific, 12am Eastern.

We broadcast LIVE every night. #UFO #UAP #AlienDisclosure #UFOSightings #UFOCoverUp #Aliens #SpacedOutRadio #Paranormal #UFOCommunity #disclosure
